sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after the statement of the victim was recorded, a fresh statement was got recorded on 14.03.2024 wherein she specifically stated that the applicant was not the person who committed the offence.
In light of the said statement, he prays that bail application may be granted.

Learned A.G.A. states that the fact witnesses have already been examined and informal witnesses are to be examined, the medical is on record which prima facie corroborates the allegations levelled in the F.I.R.
On due consideration to the age of the victim to be 6-7 years, nature of allegations levelled which are corroborated by the medical report, I do not find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
The trial court is directed to ensure that the trial is concluded with expedition preferably within a period of four months as only informal witnesses are to be examined.
The trial court shall not grant any adjournment to any of the parties unless extremely urgent.
The Superintendent of Police, Sitapur is directed to ensure that informal witnesses are produced for their deposition before the trial court.
The applicant would be at liberty to revive the bail application after the statements were recorded.

Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Saurabh Yadav/-
